name: Graph view
description: The vault as a graph: files are dots, [[links]] the lines between them. Open it as a tab, see a file's neighbours in the sidebar, or put a local graph in any file.

search.label: Filter
search.description: only the files this search matches; in the whole graph, the search syntax (words, tag:#x, type:person, folder:Notes, [status:done]...), the graph's search box

tags.label: Show tags
tags.description: as dots, linked to the files that have them

attachments.label: Show attachments
attachments.description: images, PDFs and drawings; files that aren't notes, as dots when something links to them

orphans.label: Show files with no links
orphans.description: files nothing links to, and that link to nothing; in the whole graph

archived.label: Show archived files
archived.description: left out of the graph unless this is on

hidden.label: Hidden folders and types
hidden.description: like `folder:Logs` or `type:log`; left out of the whole graph (a top folder's or a type's exact name)

hiddenLinks.label: Hidden link types
hiddenLinks.description: link types left out: a frontmatter key links are under (project for project: "[[Lighthouse]]"), or body for links in the text

colorBy.label: Colour by
colorBy.description: a dot's colour outside the groups; none: grey

groups.label: Groups
groups.description: colour groups, first match wins; the user's, [{"query": "tag:#work", "color": "blue"}] (a search query; a colour gray, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, indigo, purple or pink; "hidden": true leaves its files out)

linkColors.label: Link colours
linkColors.description: a colour per link type, others grey; like {"project": "orange"} (gray, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, indigo, purple or pink)

depth.label: Local graph depth
depth.description: how many links away from the file

incoming.label: Incoming links
incoming.description: follows the links to a file

outgoing.label: Outgoing links
outgoing.description: follows the links from a file

neighbors.label: Neighbor links
neighbors.description: between the files around it; not only those leading out from it

textFade.label: Text fade threshold
textFade.description: when names show as you zoom in; below 0 sooner, above 0 only closer

nodeSize.label: Node size
nodeSize.description: dots' size, times the usual (2: twice as big)

center.label: Center force
center.description: how strongly files are pulled to the middle; times the usual

repel.label: Repel force
repel.description: how strongly files push each other apart; times the usual

linkDistance.label: Link distance
linkDistance.description: how long links are, times the usual

graph.description: a file's local graph: its neighbours in the vault, files as dots and links as lines

depth.description: how many links away to go
